cases.name: CHK-001 happy: discarded stories no longer count as unfinished
cases.execute: const { mkdtempSync, mkdirSync, rmSync, writeFileSync } = await import('fs'); const { tmpdir } = await import('os'); const { join } = await import('path'); const { StoryStore } = await import($root + '/packages/main/dist/core/store.js'); const { checkConvergence } = await import($root + '/packages/main/dist/tasks/gap-analyze.js'); const root = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'koala-conv-done-')); try { mkdirSync(join(root, 'packages', 'main', 'src'), { recursive: true }); mkdirSync(join(root, 'docs', 'requirements'), { recursive: true }); writeFileSync(join(root, 'koala.config.json'), JSON.stringify({ scanRoot: 'packages/main', rootDir: 'src', outDir: 'packages/main/dist', testsDir: 'packages/main/tests', fixturesDir: 'packages/main/tests/fixtures', storyDir: 'docs/story/actives', requirementsDir: 'docs/requirements', storyPrefix: 'B' }, null, 2)); const store = new StoryStore(root); const now = new Date().toISOString(); store.writeStory('B-done', { storyId: 'B-done', name: 'done', title: 'done', description: 'done', type: 'chore', phase: 'DONE', priority: 'low', createdAt: now, startedAt: now, endedAt: now }); store.writeStory('B-discard', { storyId: 'B-discard', name: 'discard', title: 'discard', description: 'discard', type: 'chore', phase: 'DISCARDED', priority: 'low', createdAt: now, startedAt: now, endedAt: now }); const result = checkConvergence(root, store); const storyCheck = result.checks.find((c) => c.name === '所有 Story 完成'); return { passed: storyCheck?.passed === true, detail: storyCheck?.detail || '' }; } finally { rmSync(root, { recursive: true, force: true }); }

cases.name: CHK-001 edge: done and discarded both stay out of unfinished list
cases.execute: const { mkdtempSync, mkdirSync, rmSync, writeFileSync } = await import('fs'); const { tmpdir } = await import('os'); const { join } = await import('path'); const { StoryStore } = await import($root + '/packages/main/dist/core/store.js'); const { checkConvergence } = await import($root + '/packages/main/dist/tasks/gap-analyze.js'); const root = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'koala-conv-edge-')); try { mkdirSync(join(root, 'packages', 'main', 'src'), { recursive: true }); mkdirSync(join(root, 'docs', 'requirements'), { recursive: true }); writeFileSync(join(root, 'koala.config.json'), JSON.stringify({ scanRoot: 'packages/main', rootDir: 'src', outDir: 'packages/main/dist', testsDir: 'packages/main/tests', fixturesDir: 'packages/main/tests/fixtures', storyDir: 'docs/story/actives', requirementsDir: 'docs/requirements', storyPrefix: 'B' }, null, 2)); const store = new StoryStore(root); const now = new Date().toISOString(); store.writeStory('B-done', { storyId: 'B-done', name: 'done', title: 'done', description: 'done', type: 'chore', phase: 'DONE', priority: 'low', createdAt: now, startedAt: now, endedAt: now }); store.writeStory('B-discard', { storyId: 'B-discard', name: 'discard', title: 'discard', description: 'discard', type: 'chore', phase: 'DISCARDED', priority: 'low', createdAt: now, startedAt: now, endedAt: now }); store.writeStory('B-dev', { storyId: 'B-dev', name: 'dev', title: 'dev', description: 'dev', type: 'feature', phase: 'DEV', priority: 'medium', createdAt: now, startedAt: now, endedAt: null }); const result = checkConvergence(root, store); const storyCheck = result.checks.find((c) => c.name === '所有 Story 完成'); return { passed: storyCheck?.passed === false, mentionsOnlyDev: (storyCheck?.detail || '').includes('B-dev') && !(storyCheck?.detail || '').includes('B-discard') && !(storyCheck?.detail || '').includes('B-done') }; } finally { rmSync(root, { recursive: true, force: true }); }

cases.name: CHK-001 adversarial: active phases still count as unfinished
cases.execute: const { mkdtempSync, mkdirSync, rmSync, writeFileSync } = await import('fs'); const { tmpdir } = await import('os'); const { join } = await import('path'); const { StoryStore } = await import($root + '/packages/main/dist/core/store.js'); const { checkConvergence } = await import($root + '/packages/main/dist/tasks/gap-analyze.js'); const root = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'koala-conv-active-')); try { mkdirSync(join(root, 'packages', 'main', 'src'), { recursive: true }); mkdirSync(join(root, 'docs', 'requirements'), { recursive: true }); writeFileSync(join(root, 'koala.config.json'), JSON.stringify({ scanRoot: 'packages/main', rootDir: 'src', outDir: 'packages/main/dist', testsDir: 'packages/main/tests', fixturesDir: 'packages/main/tests/fixtures', storyDir: 'docs/story/actives', requirementsDir: 'docs/requirements', storyPrefix: 'B' }, null, 2)); const store = new StoryStore(root); const now = new Date().toISOString(); for (const phase of ['INIT','PLAN','DEV','TEST']) { store.writeStory('B-' + phase.toLowerCase(), { storyId: 'B-' + phase.toLowerCase(), name: phase.toLowerCase(), title: phase, description: phase, type: 'feature', phase, priority: 'medium', createdAt: now, startedAt: now, endedAt: null }); } const result = checkConvergence(root, store); const storyCheck = result.checks.find((c) => c.name === '所有 Story 完成'); const detail = storyCheck?.detail || ''; return { countsActivePhases: ['B-init','B-plan','B-dev','B-test'].every((id) => detail.includes(id)) }; } finally { rmSync(root, { recursive: true, force: true }); }
